headline: End the war in Iran
evidence_note: Polled as a negotiated ceasefire or deal (median 59%), ending the war as the top U.S. goal (50%), and full withdrawal (27%).

headline: End financial and military support to Israel
evidence_note: Polls in the sweep ask only about military aid (reduce or end: median 48%). No national poll on ending financial aid was found.

headline: Raise taxes on the wealthy
evidence_note: Every version polled has majority support; thresholds range from $400,000 of income to $50 million of wealth.

headline: Raise capital gains taxes
evidence_note: Polled as taxing capital gains like wages above $1 million and closing the carried-interest loophole.

headline: Invest in small towns and small businesses
evidence_note: No direct national poll found in the sweep. Rural broadband investment is the closest polled demand.

headline: Healthcare for all
evidence_note: Polled as Medicare for All (8 polls) and a public option anyone can buy into; covering every child is an unpolled proposal.
